glasgow_home_a_mrmackay.text: Come in, come in, wipe your feet. In a Glasgow tenement the shared entrance is the close, and the back garden is the back green.
Wee word for you: gallus. It means bold, cheeky, with a bit of a swagger. Said with a grin, it is the highest compliment.

then.text: That is the lot for today, I am afraid. Mind how you go.

else.text: Here, a bit of tablet. It is butter, sugar and condensed milk, and one square is never enough.
